question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.5.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Effectively ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Adding -**ly **to an adjective makes an adverb. • An **adverb **is used to provide more information about the verb or the action in the sentence. • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Eloquently**: In a fluent or persuasive manner. (धाराप्रवाह या प्रेरक तरीके से) • **Effectively**: In such a manner as to achieve the desired result. (जिससे मनोवांछित फल की प्राप्ति हो सके) • **Abruptly**: In a sudden, unexpected, and sometimes unpleasant way. (अचानक, अप्रत्याशित और कभी-कभी अप्रिय तरीके से) • **Affectively**: In an emotional manner. (भावनात्मक तरीके से) • So, as per the meaning of the given words "**effectively**" is the most appropriate option. Therefore, the correct answer is option 2. By __(2) __*__*outlawing*__ *child marriage, the best possible future for children can be __(3) __*__envisioned__*.
